title: AuraAC
description: AuraAC is a lightweight and stealthy anti-cheat plugin for Minecraft that protects your server from popular cheats like Speed, Fly, and KillAura. The system operates discreetly for regular players, notifying them.
body:
# **AuraAC**
![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/903fc9ec7287c57ac60a9b7fa73b098a066dec57.png)                  
**AuraAC** is a lightweight, high-performance anti-cheat plugin designed to protect your Minecraft server from common unfair gameplay without sacrificing performance. It is built to be unobtrusive for legitimate players while effectively mitigating common threats.

✨ Why choose AuraAC?

**Lightweight**: Optimized code for minimal CPU usage. It runs smoothly even on high-traffic servers.

Universal Compatibility: Stable performance on Paper, Spigot, and CraftBukkit.

**Stability**: Designed to minimize false positives, ensuring a smooth experience for your community.

🛡️ What we protect against
AuraAC focuses on preventing the most common types of cheats:

**Flight**, **Jesus**, **KillAura etc**.

⚙️ Requirements
**Java 16+ (Required for execution)**.

💡 User Information

**Installation**: Simply drop the .jar file into your /plugins folder and restart your server.

**Open Source**: We believe in transparency. Check out our source code on **[GitHub](https://github.com/EmilLC-Minecraft/AuraAC)**.

This project is built to contribute high-quality, reliable tools to the Minecraft community.
